definitions.explanation: Not containing carbon compounds that come from living things, as in minerals, water and metals. Mainly a term of chemistry, used in compounds such as {無機物|むきぶつ} and {無機|むき}{化学|かがく}.

examples.japanese: {無機|むき}⟦{化合物|かごうぶつ}→化合物：25020_kagoubutsu⟧。
⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧や⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無機物|むきぶつ}→無機物：18086_mukibutsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Water and salt are inorganic substances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧で、⟦{無機質|むきしつ}→無機質：19700_mukishitsu⟧な⟦{感|かん}じ→感じ：02555_kanji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: His room has only white walls and metal furniture, so it feels cold and impersonal.

notes:
The opposite of ⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧ (organic). In everyday speech the compound ⟦{無機質|むきしつ}→無機質：19700_mukishitsu⟧ is used figuratively for something cold, sterile or lacking human warmth.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{無機物|むきぶつ}→無機物：18086_mukibutsu⟧: inorganic matter
- {無機|むき}⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧: inorganic chemistry
- {無機|むき}⟦{化合物|かごうぶつ}→化合物：25020_kagoubutsu⟧: inorganic compound
- ⟦{無機質|むきしつ}→無機質：19700_mukishitsu⟧な: (figurative) cold, impersonal, sterile (⟦{無機質|むきしつ}→無機質：19700_mukishitsu⟧な⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧, a flat, mechanical voice)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧: organic (⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧, organic vegetables)
